verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs recommend creating separate projects for staging and production, and allow multiple organizations. That gives a documented way to keep test error data apart from production. It is project-level separation, not a dedicated sandbox environment or test mode, and there is nothing about isolated test credentials or agent-safe testing. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test-mode environment, documented data isolation guarantees, agent-oriented guidance for testing against non-production data, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: to make separate projects for your staging and production instances
you will be able to make as many organizations as you need
Send a test event to verify your setup: glitchtip-cli send-event -m "Test event from CLI"
